# MultiHelm (多店舵跨境工作台)

> MultiHelm is a self-hosted workbench (ERP) for sellers who run many Ozon stores and source products from Chinese marketplaces. It brings multi-store orders, purchase records, first-sale and tiered repricing, domestic logistics tracking, inventory and issue tickets into one system. Each customer gets a separate instance on their own server.

## Facts

- Platform: Ozon
- Best for: Sellers with 10 or more stores who buy from Chinese marketplaces such as 1688 and Pinduoduo
- Deployment: Self-hosted, one isolated instance per customer
- Interface language: Simplified Chinese
- Delivery: Demo → deployment → trial run → final payment after acceptance, then monthly maintenance
- Pricing: Quoted by number of stores and modules
- Affiliation: independent third-party tool, not affiliated with Ozon

## What it does

- All stores' orders, handled on one page. Filter by account, store, status or order number. Pull new orders, sync status, print labels in bulk and split orders. Purchase platform, purchase order number, cost and courier are recorded on the order row; the page footer totals sales, known cost and estimated profit.
- Repricing and promotion: preview first, then confirm. Read and process many stores together. Every write follows the same rule: preview → confirm → write once → read back to verify.
- Know where the goods are without asking. Domestic logistics tracking separates parcels not yet tracked, awaiting pickup, in transit and signed for, and filters orders signed for days ago but not yet shipped. Inventory, shelves and issue tickets sit in the same system, so warehouse and operations stop relaying messages in chat.

## Who it is for

- Ozon sellers with 10 or more stores
- Buying from Chinese marketplaces and recording purchases on each order
- Own warehouse or a fixed partner warehouse
- Want data and store keys on their own server
- Team can work in a Chinese-language interface

## Who it is not for

- One or two stores: a free general-purpose ERP is enough
- Want software to download and install yourself
- Need one tool across Amazon, Temu and other platforms
- Need an English or Russian interface today

## Questions and answers

### Where is the data stored?

On your own server. We log in only for deployment and maintenance.

### Do we have to replace our current tools?

No. Start with one or two stores in parallel and expand when it works for you.

### What happens when Ozon changes its API or rules?

Adapting to API and rule changes is part of monthly maintenance, along with incident handling.

### How much does it cost?

A one-time deployment fee plus a monthly maintenance fee, quoted by number of stores and modules after the demo.

### Can we try it before paying in full?

Yes. Demo first, then a trial run with one or two stores. The final payment is due only after acceptance.

### Is it affiliated with Ozon?

No. It is an independent third-party tool; the platform name only describes where it is used.

### What language is the interface in?

Simplified Chinese at the moment.

### Is it suitable for one or two stores?

No. With one or two stores a free general-purpose ERP is enough.

## 中文说明

多店舵跨境工作台是一套给 Ozon 多店卖家用的私有部署工作台（ERP）。它把多店订单、国内采购信息回填、首单与阶梯改价、国内物流监控、库存与问题件工单放在同一个系统里。每个客户一套独立实例，部署在客户自己的服务器上。

- 适用平台：Ozon
- 适合：10 家店以上、在国内平台采购的卖家
- 部署方式：私有部署，一个客户一套独立实例
- 界面语言：简体中文
- 交付流程：演示 → 部署 → 试运行 → 验收后付尾款，之后按月维护
- 价格：按店铺数量和模块报价
